```yaml
name: Version Upload

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'feature/**'
      - 'release/**'
      - 'hotfix/**'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-upload:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build

      - name: Determine version tag
        id: version
        run: |
          BRANCH_NAME="${GITHUB_REF#refs/heads/}"
          SHORT_SHA="${GITHUB_SHA::7}"
          TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)
          VERSION_TAG="${BRANCH_NAME//\//_}-${SHORT_SHA}-${TIMESTAMP}"
          echo "version_tag=${VERSION_TAG}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Package artifact
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist-package
          cp -r dist/* dist-package/
          cp package.json dist-package/
          cp README.md dist-package/
          tar -czf sentry-mcp-${{ steps.version.outputs.version_tag }}.tar.gz -C dist-package .

      - name: Upload artifact to GitHub
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: sentry-mcp-${{ steps.version.outputs.version_tag }}
          path: sentry-mcp-${{ steps.version.outputs.version_tag }}.tar.gz
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Upload to GitHub Release (if tag exists)
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          files: sentry-mcp-${{ steps.version.outputs.version_tag }}.tar.gz
          name: Version ${{ steps.version.outputs.version_tag }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: true
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Notify deployment status
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "Version upload job completed with status: ${{ job.status }}"
          echo "Version tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version_tag }}"
```
